psp_remote_title: Title of the internet radio station.
fs_hasitems: Whether or not an item has sub-items. May indicate the number of sub-items
fs_url: URL of the station or track
fs_isaudio: Whether or not an favorite is audio
ss_lastscan: Timestamp of the last server scan
ss_uuid: Unique ID of the LMS/Lyrion server
ss_player count: Number of players known by Squeezebox Server
ss_sn player count: Number of players connected to the current mysqueezebox.com account
ss_other player count: Number of players connected to other discovered Squeezebox Servers in the local network
ss_otherServers: Information about other LMS/Lyrion servers in the network
psm_player_connected: Connection status of the playback device
psm_power: Power status of the playback device
psm_mode: Readable mode of the playback device
psm_time: Elapsed time into the current song. Decimal seconds. Only if current song
psm_rate: Player rate. Only if there is a current song
psm_sync_slaves: List of player IDs, slaves to sync_master in the sync group this player belongs to. Only if synced.
psm_sync_master: ID of the master player in the sync group this player belongs to. Only if synced
psm_mixer volume: Current volume of the playback device
psm_playlist repeat: 0 no repeat, 1 repeat song, 2 repeat playlist.
psm_playlist shuffle: 0 no shuffle, 1 shuffle songs, 2 shuffle albums.
psm_remote: Returns 1 if a remote stream is currently playing.
psm_playlist: JSON of the current playlist information
psm_playlist_cur_index: Index of the current song in the playlist
psm_state: Numerical status of the current playback device. 0=pause, 1=play, 2=stop
psl_artwork_url: A full URL to remote artwork.
psl_coverid: Coverid to use when constructing an artwork URL
psl_remote_title: Title of the internet radio station.
pb_cmdPlayFavorite: Command to play a favorite, set the id of the favorite
pb_announce: Play an announcement from an absolute file path or HTTP(S) URL
psp_playlist index: Index of the current song in the playlist
psp_artwork_url: A full URL to remote artwork.
psp_coverid: Coverid to use when constructing an artwork URL
